hero.title: Over 100,000 Souls Reached, Restored and Discipled for Christ
hero.subtitle: A Protestant Christian non-profit coalition based around Lake Péligre, Thomonde, and across the Haitian Central Plateau for spiritual revival and tangible social impact.

president.quote: Our passion is rooted in the conviction that every single soul across the Central Plateau hills and around Lake Péligre has invaluable worth before God. By 2050, by God's grace and through genuine church unity, we strive to build a generation of devoted disciples.
president.author: Julberson TOUTOUTE
president.role: President of the Executive Committee — Association 100,000 Souls (AMA)

pillars.title: Our 4 Core Pillars of Action
pillars.subtitle: A holistic Christian outreach combining Gospel proclamation, youth discipleship, and practical community aid.

donations.title: Support Our Work / Make a Donation
donations.subtitle: Your generous contribution helps fund evangelistic crusades, youth sports leagues, and relief for vulnerable families.
